cr_data.provenance: Private collection, Abiquiu, New Mexico, gift, 1984; (Gerald Peters Gallery, Santa Fe, New Mexico); Greenberg Van Doren Gallery, St. Louis, Missouri, 1995 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: Two white calla lilies contrast dramatically with a dark background surrounding them. The outer petals of the lilies are yellow, and they have dark green stems. The work's background is dark surrounding the flowers, and it fades to white near the borders of the composition.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
title: Untitled (Calla Lilies)
